messages:
Priya: Clearing out some gear from the SF office this week: 1x 27" 144Hz monitor (BenQ, small scratch but works fine), 1x Herman Miller-style task chair (black), and two GA tickets to a local comedy night (Friday). Free pickup, or I can drop at lobby after 4pm. Photos: https://imgur.com/a/priya-clearout :grinning:
Sam: Comedy night tickets? count me curious. Are they paper or digital?
Priya: Digital transfer for the tickets. Monitor has DP + HDMI. Chair is light-use, adjustable lumbar.
Noah: I can take the chair if nobody else needs it. Will be in the office tomorrow.
Lily: Would love the monitor if it's 27" and 144hz. What's the exact model?
Priya: It's a BenQ EX2780Q. There is a tiny scrape on the lower bezel (pictured). Works perfectly for games/dev.
Sam: If monitor's left I'll take it, but I can only pick up after 6pm. Is that ok?
Priya: After-hours pickup is fine but must be logged with security. ops-bot, any note?
ops-bot: Reminder: all after-hours pickups require a security sign-out form (frontdesk/sigout) and the person picking up must show ID. Bookings via frontdesk calendar preferred.
Noah: I'm happy to pick up the chair during business hours tomorrow. I'll DM you to confirm.
Lily: If Sam can't do after 6, I can grab the monitor at 5pm. Lily: also willing to swap my Logitech MX Master 3 if anyone wants to trade for the tickets.
Sam: I might be able to push my day to grab it at 5:30 — will confirm in 10m.
Priya: Cool. Plan: Chair -> Noah, Monitor tentative for Sam @5:30, Tickets -> open until Sam confirms, swap offers welcome. I'll leave a sticky note on the items with names.
Lily: DM'd you about the mouse swap.
Sam: Confirmed, I can pick up the monitor at 5:30. I'll log it with front desk. Venmo for a coffee? :coffee:
Priya: Nah all free, but bring snacks next week :joy:. Thanks everyone. I'll update here if anything changes.
